_doc: Practical, verifiable skills for the Skill Passport. Each task has steps, evidence to upload, and a rubric of pass/needs-work criteria. careers lists career slugs from careers.json.

tasks.title: Wire a switch and bulb on a practice board

title_i18n.hi: प्रैक्टिस बोर्ड पर स्विच और बल्ब जोड़ें
title_i18n.mr: सराव बोर्डवर स्विच आणि बल्ब जोडा

tasks.instructions: Wire one switch controlling one bulb on a dead (unpowered) practice board, with a teacher or trained electrician present.
steps: Switch OFF the main supply and confirm with a tester that the board is dead.
Connect phase (red) through the switch to the bulb holder; neutral (black) straight to the holder.
Check every screw is tight and no bare copper is visible.
Photograph the board before powering on and have your supervisor test it.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: the full board, and a close-up of the connections. Note: who supervised.

rubric.title: Wire a switch and bulb on a practice board rubric

criteria.name: Safety first
criteria.pass_text: Main supply was switched off and tested before work started

criteria.name: Correct wiring
criteria.pass_text: Phase goes through the switch; neutral goes directly to the holder

criteria.name: Neat connections
criteria.pass_text: No loose strands or bare copper; screws tight

skills.name: Measure voltage and continuity with a multimeter

name_i18n.hi: मल्टीमीटर से वोल्टेज और कंटीन्यूटी मापना

tasks.title: Measure a battery and test a wire
tasks.instructions: Use a multimeter to read a cell or battery voltage and test a wire for continuity.
steps: Set the dial to DC voltage and touch the probes to the battery ends; note the reading.
Set the dial to continuity (beep) and test a good wire and a broken wire.
Write both readings on paper.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: the multimeter showing the battery reading, and the continuity test. Note: the readings.

rubric.title: Measure a battery and test a wire rubric

criteria.name: Right setting
criteria.pass_text: Dial set correctly for each test

criteria.name: Reading recorded
criteria.pass_text: Voltage reading written and sensible for the battery

criteria.name: Continuity result
criteria.pass_text: Correctly identified good and broken wire

tasks.title: Measure open-circuit voltage of a panel
tasks.instructions: Measure the open-circuit voltage of a small solar panel in sunlight and clean its surface.
steps: Wipe the panel with a soft damp cloth.
Face it to the sun, set the multimeter to DC volts and touch the red probe to + and black to -.
Note the voltage and the time of day.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: panel in sun, multimeter reading. Note: rated voltage vs measured.

rubric.title: Measure open-circuit voltage of a panel rubric

criteria.name: Safe handling
criteria.pass_text: No damage to wires or panel

skills.name: Join and seal a pipe fitting

tasks.title: Make a leak-free threaded joint

title_i18n.hi: बिना रिसाव का थ्रेडेड जोड़ बनाएं

tasks.instructions: Join two threaded pipe pieces with teflon tape and test with water.
steps: Wrap teflon tape 4-5 times clockwise on the male thread.
Screw the fitting by hand, then tighten with a wrench by 1-2 turns.
Run water and watch the joint for 2 minutes.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: the finished joint, and the joint under running water.

rubric.title: Make a leak-free threaded joint rubric

criteria.name: Tape applied
criteria.pass_text: Tape wrapped in the right direction on clean threads

criteria.name: No leak
criteria.pass_text: No drips after 2 minutes under water

criteria.name: Tools used well
criteria.pass_text: Wrench used safely, pipe not crushed

tasks.title: Weld a straight bead on mild steel
tasks.instructions: With an instructor present and full protective gear, run a 10 cm bead on a steel plate.
steps: Wear helmet, gloves and apron; clear flammable items away.
Strike the arc and move steadily along a marked line.
Chip off slag and brush clean.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: you in protective gear, and the cleaned bead. Note: electrode used.

rubric.title: Weld a straight bead on mild steel rubric

criteria.name: Even bead
criteria.pass_text: Width and height fairly even, no big gaps

tasks.title: Patch a tube and refit the tyre
tasks.instructions: Find the hole in a tube using water, patch it and refit.
steps: Dip the inflated tube in water and mark the bubbles.
Roughen, apply solution, wait, press the patch for 1 minute.
Refit and inflate; check no air escapes.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: the marked hole, and the finished patch. Note: tyre pressure used.

rubric.title: Patch a tube and refit the tyre rubric

criteria.name: Patch applied
criteria.pass_text: Surface roughened, solution dried, patch pressed

criteria.name: Refit
criteria.pass_text: Tyre and tube refitted without pinching

skills.name: Change engine oil on a two-wheeler

tasks.title: Drain and refill engine oil
tasks.instructions: Change the oil of a cold two-wheeler with an experienced mechanic watching.
steps: Put the vehicle on its stand and place a tray under the drain bolt.
Drain fully, refit the bolt with a new washer.
Fill to the correct level on the dipstick.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: old oil in tray, dipstick showing correct level.

rubric.title: Drain and refill engine oil rubric

criteria.name: Clean work
criteria.pass_text: No spills, waste oil kept safely

skills.name: Inspect an EV battery pack safely

tasks.title: Visual and safety checklist of a battery
tasks.instructions: Do a visual inspection of a (disconnected) e-bike or e-rickshaw battery with a supervisor.
steps: Confirm the battery is disconnected and insulated gloves are worn.
Check for swelling, cracks, burn marks and loose terminals.
Fill the checklist and mark any problem.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: battery front/back, terminals close-up. Note: checklist result.

rubric.title: Visual and safety checklist of a battery rubric

tasks.title: Replace a screen on a practice phone
tasks.instructions: On a spare or practice phone, replace a cracked screen.
steps: Power off, heat edges lightly, lift the screen with a pick.
Disconnect battery and display connectors; swap the screen.
Reassemble, power on and test touch.
tasks.evidence: 3 photos: cracked phone, opened phone, finished phone with display on.

rubric.title: Replace a screen on a practice phone rubric

criteria.name: Safe opening
criteria.pass_text: Battery disconnected first, no cracked frame

criteria.name: Correct fit
criteria.pass_text: New screen seated and connected properly

criteria.name: Working
criteria.pass_text: Touch and display work after repair

criteria.name: Tidy
criteria.pass_text: Screws sorted and all parts back

tasks.title: Measure a part with a vernier caliper
tasks.instructions: Take 3 measurements of a part and compare with the drawing.
steps: Close the caliper and check it reads zero.
Measure length, width and thickness.
Compare with the drawing sizes and note the difference.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: the caliper on the part, and your notes.

rubric.title: Measure a part with a vernier caliper rubric

tasks.title: Cut and fit a lap joint
tasks.instructions: Mark, cut and glue a half-lap joint between two pieces of wood.
steps: Mark with pencil and try-square.
Saw inside the line and chisel the waste.
Glue and clamp for 30 minutes.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: marked wood, finished joint.

rubric.title: Cut and fit a lap joint rubric

criteria.name: Clean cuts
criteria.pass_text: Cut inside the line, no splits

criteria.name: Tight fit
criteria.pass_text: Pieces fit with no big gap

name_i18n.hi: ईंटें सीधी और लेवल में लगाना

tasks.title: Build a 5-course wall
tasks.instructions: Build a small wall of 5 courses with mortar and check with plumb line and spirit level.
steps: Mix mortar 1:4 and lay the first course on a line.
Stagger joints and check each course with a spirit level.
Check the wall with a plumb line.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: wall from front and side with the level on it.

rubric.title: Build a 5-course wall rubric

skills.name: Measure and cut cloth to a pattern

name_i18n.hi: कपड़ा नाप कर पैटर्न से काटना

tasks.title: Cut a kurta front panel

title_i18n.hi: कुर्ते का आगे का हिस्सा काटें

tasks.instructions: Take body measurements and cut one panel using a paper pattern.
steps: Measure chest, length and shoulder of a person.
Draw the pattern on paper and add seam allowance.
Pin to cloth and cut along the line.
tasks.evidence: 3 photos: measurements written, paper pattern, cut cloth.

rubric.title: Cut a kurta front panel rubric

criteria.name: Cloth saving
criteria.pass_text: Pattern placed to waste little cloth

tasks.title: Stitch a neat French seam
tasks.instructions: Sew two cloth pieces with a straight, even seam.
steps: Set thread tension on a scrap first.
Sew with 1 cm seam allowance, backstitch at ends.
Press the seam flat.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: the seam from both sides.

rubric.title: Stitch a neat French seam rubric

criteria.name: Even stitches
criteria.pass_text: Stitch length equal, no skipped stitches

skills.name: Do a basic facial with hygiene

tasks.title: Complete a basic facial on a volunteer
tasks.instructions: Do cleansing, steam, and massage on a consenting adult with a trainer present.
steps: Wash hands and sanitise tools.
Cleanse, steam briefly, massage, apply pack.
Clean up the area.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: your prepared tray and the clean workstation (no faces needed).

rubric.title: Complete a basic facial on a volunteer rubric

skills.name: Cook a meal with food hygiene

tasks.title: Cook dal-rice for 4 hygienically
tasks.instructions: Prepare dal and rice following hygiene steps.
steps: Wash hands, tie hair, wash vegetables and grains.
Cook dal and rice properly; taste for salt.
Serve with clean utensils.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: ingredients washed, finished dishes.

rubric.title: Cook dal-rice for 4 hygienically rubric

criteria.name: Cooked well
criteria.pass_text: Dal and rice cooked, not raw or burnt

tasks.title: Role-play a guest check-in
tasks.instructions: Do a role-play check-in with a classmate and write the steps.
steps: Greet politely and ask the name.
Fill the register and collect ID details.
Explain room, timings and hand over the key.
tasks.evidence: 1 photo of your filled register/form, and a note of what you said.

rubric.title: Role-play a guest check-in rubric

tasks.title: Check tyres, lights, brakes and fluids
tasks.instructions: Run through a checklist on a vehicle before driving.
steps: Check tyre pressure and tread.
Test lights, indicators and horn.
Check brake feel and engine oil/coolant.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: checklist filled, a tyre being checked.

rubric.title: Check tyres, lights, brakes and fluids rubric

tasks.title: Count 10 items and fill a stock register
tasks.instructions: Count items in a shop or store and record in a register.
steps: Pick 10 different items.
Count each twice.
Write item, quantity and date in a register.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: items on the shelf and the filled register.

rubric.title: Count 10 items and fill a stock register rubric

skills.name: Make a basic spreadsheet with formulas

tasks.title: Build an expense sheet with SUM
tasks.instructions: Make a monthly expense table with totals in a spreadsheet app.
steps: Make columns: date, item, amount.
Enter at least 10 rows.
Use SUM for the total and bold the header.
tasks.evidence: 2 screenshots/photos of the sheet on screen, one showing the formula.

rubric.title: Build an expense sheet with SUM rubric

tasks.title: Type a paragraph in 5 minutes
tasks.instructions: Type a given paragraph in 5 minutes and check mistakes.
steps: Use any typing test or a copy of a printed paragraph.
Type for 5 minutes without looking at keys if possible.
Count words and mistakes.
tasks.evidence: Screenshot/photo of the result with words and mistakes.

rubric.title: Type a paragraph in 5 minutes rubric

tasks.title: Fill a practice form and upload documents
tasks.instructions: Fill a sample online form (e.g. scholarship practice form) and upload scanned documents.
steps: Gather documents and check name spelling.
Fill all fields, upload, preview.
Save the acknowledgement (do not submit real private data).
tasks.evidence: 2 screenshots: filled form, preview page. Cover personal numbers.

rubric.title: Fill a practice form and upload documents rubric

criteria.name: Privacy
criteria.pass_text: Private data covered or practice data used

tasks.title: Write a program that prints a multiplication table
tasks.instructions: Write a program (any language) that prints the table of a number given by the user.
steps: Ask for a number.
Use a loop 1 to 10.
Run and show output for two numbers.
tasks.evidence: 2 screenshots: the code and the output.

rubric.title: Write a program that prints a multiplication table rubric

criteria.name: Input
criteria.pass_text: Takes a number from the user

tasks.title: Make a one-page profile in HTML
tasks.instructions: Make a page with a heading, photo, paragraph and a link.
steps: Write HTML with h1, img, p and a.
Open in a browser.
Resize to phone width and check it reads well.
tasks.evidence: 2 screenshots: the page on laptop and in phone view.

rubric.title: Make a one-page profile in HTML rubric

tasks.title: Design a poster for a school event
tasks.instructions: Design a poster with a title, date, venue and one image.
steps: Sketch layout on paper.
Make it in Canva or by hand.
Check text is large and readable.
tasks.evidence: 1-2 photos or screenshots of the poster.

rubric.title: Design a poster for a school event rubric

tasks.title: Shoot 3 photos with good light and framing
tasks.instructions: Take 3 photos of an object using rule of thirds and natural light.
steps: Place the subject off-centre on the grid.
Use window or outdoor light, not harsh flash.
Pick the sharpest shot.
tasks.evidence: 3 photos.

rubric.title: Shoot 3 photos with good light and framing rubric

criteria.name: Framing
criteria.pass_text: Subject placed by rule of thirds

tasks.title: Record a 30-second explainer
tasks.instructions: Record a 30-second video explaining something you know. Upload a screenshot and a short note.
steps: Write 3 lines first.
Record in a quiet place with steady phone.
Check sound and face lighting.
tasks.evidence: 1-2 photos (frame of the video, setup) and note describing the topic.

rubric.title: Record a 30-second explainer rubric

tasks.title: Measure and record BP of a volunteer
tasks.instructions: Measure blood pressure of an adult volunteer with trainer present.
steps: Seat volunteer calmly for 5 minutes, arm at heart level.
Put the cuff on bare arm, inflate and read.
Record systolic/diastolic and time.
tasks.evidence: 1 photo of the monitor/meter reading (no face) and a note of readings.

rubric.title: Measure and record BP of a volunteer rubric

tasks.title: Dress a minor wound
tasks.instructions: On a volunteer or dummy, clean and dress a small wound.
steps: Wash hands, wear gloves if available.
Clean the wound with clean water, cover with gauze.
Bandage firmly, not too tight.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: your first-aid kit and the finished dressing.

rubric.title: Dress a minor wound rubric

tasks.title: Show CPR hand position on a dummy
tasks.instructions: Show hand position and rhythm for chest compressions on a dummy or pillow.
steps: Place heel of hand at chest centre.
Compress 5 cm at 100-120 per minute.
Count aloud for 30 compressions.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos or one short note by the trainer.

rubric.title: Show CPR hand position on a dummy rubric

tasks.title: Label and handle a practice sample
tasks.instructions: With a water sample, practice labelling, gloves and disposal.
steps: Wear gloves, wash hands.
Fill container, close and label name/date/time.
Dispose of gloves safely.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: labelled container and disposal.

rubric.title: Label and handle a practice sample rubric

tasks.title: Guide a stretching routine
tasks.instructions: Guide a volunteer through 4 safe stretches.
steps: Warm up for 2 minutes.
Show each stretch slowly.
Ask about pain and stop if it hurts.
tasks.evidence: 1-2 photos of the group or setup; note listing the 4 stretches.

rubric.title: Guide a stretching routine rubric

skills.name: Check a cattle animal for health

tasks.title: Do a basic health check on a cow or goat
tasks.instructions: With the owner or vet present, check temperature, eyes, appetite and gait.
steps: Wash hands; approach calmly.
Check eyes, nose, appetite and walking.
Record observations.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos (animal from distance, your notes). Note: owner/vet name.

rubric.title: Do a basic health check on a cow or goat rubric

tasks.title: Test soil from a field with a pH kit
tasks.instructions: Collect soil from two spots and test pH with a kit or paper.
steps: Take soil from 15 cm depth at two spots.
Mix with distilled/clean water per kit.
Compare colour with the chart.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: sampling and colour chart result. Note: pH values.

rubric.title: Test soil from a field with a pH kit rubric

criteria.name: Interpretation
criteria.pass_text: Said what the pH means for crops

skills.name: Set up a drip irrigation line

tasks.title: Lay out a small drip line
tasks.instructions: Lay out a drip line for 5 plants and test.
steps: Lay the main pipe and connect the filter.
Fit drippers at each plant.
Run water and check each dripper.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: layout and water dripping at a plant.

rubric.title: Lay out a small drip line rubric

tasks.title: Maintain a cash book for one week
tasks.instructions: Record income and expenses of a small shop or home for 7 days.
steps: Make columns: date, details, in, out, balance.
Fill daily.
Check that closing balance matches cash in hand.
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: the cash book pages. Cover names/numbers.

rubric.title: Maintain a cash book for one week rubric

tasks.title: Role-play a complaint
tasks.instructions: Role-play handling an upset customer and write what you did.
steps: Listen without interrupting.
Say sorry and repeat the problem.
Offer a solution and confirm.
tasks.evidence: A note describing the situation and what you said; 1 photo of the role-play if allowed.

rubric.title: Role-play a complaint rubric

tasks.title: Make and finish one craft item
tasks.instructions: Make a small item (basket, rope mat, embroidery) with local materials.
steps: Plan the design and gather materials.
Make the item with even pattern.
Finish edges.
tasks.evidence: 3 photos: materials, in progress, finished.

rubric.title: Make and finish one craft item rubric

tasks.title: Teach a 10-minute lesson to younger children
tasks.instructions: Plan and teach a 10-minute lesson to 3 or more younger children with a teacher present.
steps: Write a 3-point plan.
Teach with an example and a question.
Check understanding with 2 questions.
tasks.evidence: 1 photo of the lesson (no faces if preferred) and your lesson plan.

rubric.title: Teach a 10-minute lesson to younger children rubric

skills.name: Read a map and survey a distance

tasks.title: Measure a 50 m distance with a tape
tasks.instructions: Measure a 50 m line with a measuring tape and draw it to scale.
steps: Mark start and end pegs.
Measure with tape, two people.
Draw a scale map (1 cm = 5 m).
tasks.evidence: 2 photos: measuring and the drawn map.

rubric.title: Measure a 50 m distance with a tape rubric

criteria.name: Accurate
criteria.pass_text: Measurement within 20 cm of the teacher's
